svg.title: Read the question first
svg.text: Query understanding: what each part of a question allows.
“…a virus. Should I switch it off?”
“Should” starts a sentence: not a name
“…per night in Tokyo?” Tokyo: a city
a source says “any city not listed”
USD 40 decides it: any rewrite keeps it
THEN, FOR QUESTIONS ONLY: THE MAP
append, never replace; chosen on dev, committed first
